items.title: Personal Data Protection Policy of the Office of the Royal Society

blocks.lead: Read or download the full personal data protection policy of the Office of the Royal Society.

blocks.heading: Rights of data subjects
blocks.lead: Under the Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (2019), as the data subject you have the following rights over your personal data.

items.title: Access and obtain a copy
items.body: Request access to and a copy of the personal data the Office holds about you.

items.title: Rectification
items.body: Ask for your personal data to be corrected so it is accurate, up to date, complete and not misleading.

items.title: Erasure
items.body: Ask for your data to be deleted, destroyed or anonymised.

items.title: Restriction
items.body: Ask for the use of your personal data to be temporarily restricted.

items.title: Objection
items.body: Object to the collection, use or disclosure of your personal data.

items.title: Data portability
items.body: Receive your data in a commonly readable format, or have it sent to another data controller.

items.title: Withdraw consent
items.body: Withdraw consent you have given at any time, unless restricted by law.

items.title: Want to exercise your rights?
items.body: Submit a data subject request to the Office online.
